derivation.mean: For the predictable marked comparison increments X_i, E[X_i | enlarged past] <= rho. At most n increments and nonnegative weights imply E[S_n] <= rho*n.
derivation.Markov: Outside Join and the separately bounded external failure event, native forest work <= w0 + S_n. For D > w0, P[forest >= D] <= min(1, rho*n/(D-w0) + delta + epsilon_ext). This does not condition the comparison law on a future good event.
derivation.mgf: For z > 1 and 0 <= x <= Wmax with Wmax > 0, convexity gives z^x <= 1 + x*(z^Wmax-1)/Wmax. Hence E[z^X_i | enlarged past] <= beta_rho = 1 + rho*(z^Wmax-1)/Wmax. Iteration for at most n marks gives E[z^S_n] <= beta_rho^n and the stated beta_rho^n/z^(D-w0) + delta + epsilon_ext tail.
derivation.without_independence: Neither derivation assumes independent opportunities or exact uniform per-key responses after prior exposures.
derivation.jump_scope: The stated deterministic Wmax premise must constrain increments of the comparison process itself. If a smaller Wmax is first established only for eligible native DAA targets outside an ancestry failure, a pre-answer w(T)<=Wmax filter defines the appropriate comparison sequence and preserves the no-bad containment. Merely bounding the eventual accepted subset would not by itself justify its unfiltered comparison MGF.
derivation.forest_scope: The counted forest consists of distinct identities represented by the old bank and the shared new-opportunity process. New external ancestry must be included in those stated allowances or in a separately bounded failure event; it is not free additional credited work.
